question: Related Questions Q. When we sleep can we read Quran that time at mobile? 14765 views Q. about quran shareef falling on ground 3398 views Q. Alhamdullillah I try to do one para daur daily (in about an hour) and try to finish it again in my salaah. Then if my mind does not feel too tired, I read the whole para again from memory, thereafter I do my sabak daur. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 50220 Country: UG Title: Listening Quran with Maine while Driving Question: Is it correct to listen to the holy Quran with Urdu translation while driving? Actually my office is far from my house so while driving I used to listen to the holy Quran with Urdu translation. Answer ID: 50220 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 239/188/D=01/1435) You may listen to it if you listen with full attention provided the translation was made by any reliable and authentic aalim. It is against the etiquette to play the cassette merely for amusement and not listening to it attentively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
